slides.title: Type Stub Files (.pyi) & Type Narrowing
slides.prompt: Type stub files (`.pyi`) provide type signatures for unannotated code/C-extensions. Type narrowing uses conditional checks (`isinstance`, `is None`, `TypeGuard`) to refine type information inside code blocks.

slides.title: Type Narrowing via isinstance
slides.prompt: How does a static type analyzer handle an `if isinstance(x, str):` branch when `x` is typed as `str | int`?
options: It narrows `x` to `str` inside the `if` block and `int` inside the `else` block
It converts `x` to `str` at runtime inside both blocks
It raises a static typing warning unless `cast` is explicitly invoked
It ignores the check unless `@runtime_checkable` is present
slides.correctAnswer: It narrows `x` to `str` inside the `if` block and `int` inside the `else` block

slides.title: typing.cast Runtime Behavior
slides.prompt: What action does `typing.cast(TargetType, val)` execute at runtime when the code is run?
options: It returns `val` directly unchanged without performing any runtime conversion or type check
It attempts to convert `val` into `TargetType` using constructor calls
It validates that `val` is an instance of `TargetType` and raises TypeError if false
It creates a proxy object wrapping `val`
slides.correctAnswer: It returns `val` directly unchanged without performing any runtime conversion or type check
